tabitha: Heads-up — flaky SSE parsing in the electron sample on Windows. Repro pretty reliably on win-latest: abort mid-stream + immediate reconnect leads to either `Unexpected token` or duplicate/reordered chunks.
ryan: which SDK and sample? any raw frames?
tabitha: browser-sdk@2.0.7 + sample-electron. Repro steps: start a stream that emits 10 small chunks, call `controller.abort()` around chunk 5, then open a new stream immediately. Often the first message after reconnect fails to parse or we get a duplicate of an earlier chunk.
mei: can you paste sanitized raw frames you logged?
tabitha: pasted below (sanitized):
```
data: {"seq":1,"txt":"a"}\\n\\n
data: {"seq":2,"txt":"b"}\\n\\n
data: {"seq":3,"txt":"c"}\\n\\n
data: {"seq":4,"txt":"d"}\\n\\n
data: {"seq":5,"txt":"e"}\\n\\n\\n<abort here>\\n[after reconnect we sometimes see:]\ndata: {"seq":6,"txt":"f"}\\n\\n\ndata: {"seq":4,"txt":"d-dup"}\\n\\n\\n[or parse error when frames glue like:]\\ndata: {"seq":5,"txt":"e"}\\ndata: {"seq":6,"txt":"f"}\\n\\n```
ryan: that glued case is the classic missing-final-newline: abort sometimes drops the trailing `\\n` so the next `data:` attaches to previous line. Our split-on-"\\n\\n" parser chokes.
mei: two-prong fix I'd suggest: 1) make parser tolerant — fallback to splitting on `\\ndata:` when `\\n\\n` split fails or when JSON.parse throws, and trim leading `data:` tokens; 2) client-side dedupe using `seq` id for a small sliding window to handle duplicates/reorder. Also add small reconnect jitter (20-200ms) on Windows CI.
tabitha: implemented a local patch that: tries `\\n\\n` split, on parse error retries by splitting on `\\ndata:` boundaries; keeps last 100 seq ids to drop duplicates; and adds 100ms jitter before reconnect on win runners. After 500 cycles win-latest flakiness dropped from 6% -> 0.4%.
ryan: nice. please add unit tests: abort mid-frame, immediate reconnect with Last-Event-ID header, duplicated chunk, and reordered chunk simulation. Also add an integration job flagged windows-only.
mei: add troubleshooting notes to sample README: enable `SDK_DEBUG_SSE=raw` and upload raw frames when filing an issue. Also recommend `SDK >= 2.0.8` which will include this fix.
ci-bot: nightly-windows build queued for branch tabitha/sse-resilience-fix — build #376 queued.
ryan: one more thought: we should avoid server changes for now. Server emitting explicit separators is nice, but network/proxy behavior and abort races mean clients must be robust. We can consider an opt-in `X-Chunk-Seq` header later to simplify dedupe if teams want.
tabitha: PR opened (WIP): https://git.redwood/example/prs/5678 — includes parser fallback tests and a small integration job. I'll post results once CI finishes. (reacted :eyes:)
mei: once CI is green, cut browser-sdk@2.0.8 patch and update electron sample. Also add changelog: "Fix: SSE parser tolerant to single-newline chunk boundaries; dedupe on reconnect; Windows jitter mitigation."
tabitha: final update: after PR merged and patch release deployed, ran 1000 abort/reconnect cycles on a Windows VM: 0 failures. leaving a note in sample-app README on diagnostics and recommended jitter. last run: 2286004630
